sloka: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे घोरा राक्षसी कामरूपिणी ।सहसा पतिता भूमौ भगिनी रावणस्य सा ।। ७.२४.२४ ॥
transliteration: etasminnantare ghorā rākṣasī kāmarūpiṇī ।sahasā patitā bhūmau bhaginī rāvaṇasya sā ।। 7.24.24 ॥

translations.english: In the meantime, that terrible Rākṣasī, Rāvaṇa's sister, who could assume any form at will, suddenly fell on the ground.
